design: G13 THE SYMMETRY CLOSURE (T198's named successors): the fourth symmetry cell + the delta-form removal PROMOTED to the registered decisive bar + the g1f replicates, each a SINGLE first-step application followed by the standard +1 read (the settled ARMED-twin read at the R=0.7-projected landing, g12's machinery verbatim). THE 2x2 COMPLETES: own-delta/own-root 0.945 (g12 A) | cons-delta/locked-root 0.109 CRUSH (g12 B) | cons-delta/cons-root 0.272 (g12 C) | locked-delta/cons-root = THE FOURTH CELL (E, this run). THE REGISTERED DECISIVE CELL (F): the AdamW-realized committed first step minus its s_0-component at g1e (g12's unadjudicated co-read 0.7075, now the bar; pre-registered prediction SPARES >= 0.5). THE g1f REPLICATES (H): both cells at the second cons root — the locked-delta transplant there and the delta-form removal there. The g12 four-cell table LOADED (gated: COMPLETE + GRADED); cells A/C re-run as the delta-object provenance gates; g1f's own-landing reference re-run as its gate (0.2577).

registered.SYMMETRY_CLOSED: SYMMETRY-CLOSED: "fires if the fourth cell holds (the locked delta spares the cons root, >= 0.5) AND the registered delta-form removal spares both cons roots (>= 0.5 each) — the 2x2 complete: the crush is delta-carried and s_0-component-made, both directions confirmed; the mechanism table closed."
registered.ASYMMETRY: ASYMMETRY: "fires if the fourth cell crushes or the removals fail to spare — the mechanism carries a direction/asymmetry not yet named; the tables verbatim."
registered.GRADED: GRADED: "any partial — the six-cell table verbatim."
registered.operationalizations: frozen BEFORE compute (they fix the clauses, they do not move the bars): the +1 read is the SETTLED ARMED-twin read at the projected landing (g11's G_LAND instrument, g12 verbatim — a CommittedGPT anchored at the root with wall R=0.7, loaded with the raw outside-ball endpoint, the first forward settles onto the ball in place; g11 reproduced the committed ledger to 2.4e-7 with it). FOURTH CELL: delta_E = the locked root's own first delta (REBUILT in-run; gated by disp 1.6543 + the cell-A reproduction of the committed 0.9452); landing_E = theta_g1e + (R/|delta_E|)*delta_E (projected at R=0.7, verbatim). REGISTERED REMOVALS (the decisive cell, promoted from g12's co-read): at each cons root R in {g1e, g1f}: delta = the root's OWN COMMITTED deltas[1] (gated vs the in-run rebuild, cos > 0.999 + rel L2 < 5%); s_0 = the unit fact-sensitivity at R (e204's convention, FD-sign-gated HARD at eps {0.05, 0.02}); delta' = delta - (delta.s_0)s_0, normalized to L2 = |delta| (the step's own raw displacement), projected verbatim: landing = theta_R + (R/|delta'|)*delta' — disclosed: the normalization and the projection are positive-constant rescalings, so the landing is theta_R + R*unit(delta_perp) exactly. CRUSH = settled +1 < 0.5; HOLD/SPARE >= 0.5 (the letter's threshold). SYMMETRY-CLOSED iff cell_E >= 0.5 AND cell_F >= 0.5 AND cell_H >= 0.5. ASYMMETRY iff cell_E < 0.5 OR (cell_F < 0.5 AND cell_H < 0.5) — 'the removals fail to spare' read JOINTLY (both fail), the reading that keeps GRADED ('any partial') reachable (the singular reading would make GRADED unreachable; both readings recorded, the joint one frozen before compute). GRADED otherwise (any partial split). THE g1f REPLICATE TRANSPLANT (the locked delta at g1f's root) and the g1f g_0-form removal ride in the replicate table, NOT in the frozen clauses (the letter's clauses name the fourth cell singular + the removals; disclosed). CO-READS (never adjudicated): the raw outside-ball endpoint read per cell (the C-arm convention); the g1f g_0-form removal (g12's registered form mirrored at g1f); the first-order ledger; the class-vs-vector confounds (cos(delta_locked, delta_cons) at both cons roots); the g12 loaded four-cell table. Hard-gate failure => the record completes, verdict TEXTURE (gate failure), nothing adjudicated.
registered.registered_prediction: frozen before compute. THE MODAL LANDING IS SYMMETRY-CLOSED (T198's closure carried to its own named cells): the crush is delta-carried (g12's cell B — the cons delta crushed the locked root to 0.109 where its own reads 0.945) while the locked delta HOLDS its own root (0.945) — a carried crush implies the LOCKED delta should not crush the cons root (E >= 0.5 predicted). The delta-form removal at g1e already read 0.7075 as g12's unadjudicated co-read — SPARES (>= 0.5) is the letter's pre-registered prediction; the re-run carries a reproduction gate (tol 0.02) as its provenance. The g1f removal (H) is the true open replicate: predicted SPARES if the normalizer mechanism is the cons axis's (n=2), not the g1e draw's. AGAINST a clean landing: the class-vs-vector confound travels with the fourth cell (the locked delta is ONE draw of the 55%-shared class, cos ~ +0.09 vs the cons delta, g11) — a cons-root crush under it would name a DIRECTION/ASYMMETRY (the cons neighborhood fragile to any same-class first step; the locked neighborhood robust to all but the cons draw); the g1f removal could fail if the s_0-component's lethality is draw-specific (g1f's own +1 breach 0.2577 was a DIFFERENT draw's fact). FALSIFIER of T198's 'made in the normalizer': the fourth cell crushes OR either removal fails to spare. No bar shopping.
registered.registration: the dispatch's registration IS the registration (the bars quoted verbatim here and in the module docstring, frozen before compute). Adjudicate against exactly this; no bar shopping.

deviations: CPU-ONLY, FORCED (g11/g12's convention; the letter's 'CPU-able at 2.74M but slow; claim short GPU bursts if free, else CPU' — g12 measured the same bundle's whole compute at ~16s CPU, so CPU is the decisive choice): CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 before torch; the GPU is never claimed; the double-polled load checks recorded at start (recorded, not gating).

THE g12 FOUR-CELL TABLE IS LOADED, NOT RECOMPUTED (the dispatch's 'read first: runs/g12/metrics.json — the four-cell table'): the four g1e-frame numbers (0.9452 / 0.1088 / 0.2719 / 0.0059) are quoted from the committed metrics.json (gated: status COMPLETE + verdict GRADED); cells A and C are RE-RUN in g13 solely as the provenance gates for the locked and g1e delta objects (tol 0.02, g12's own reference-gate convention).

THE LOCKED ROOT'S FIRST-STEP DELTA IS REBUILT (g11/g12's own deviation carried): g1b's W1 predates the resume-ckpt convention, so no committed delta vector exists for the locked root; its rebuilt delta is PRIMARY and gated by the disp-norm (1.6543) + the settled landing read vs the committed +1 (0.9452, texture tier 0.02). The cons roots' deltas are LOADED COMMITTED from their resume ckpts (deltas[1]) with the CPU rebuilds as the gates (cos > 0.999 + rel L2 < 5%, e193's G_S1CK).

THE LOCKED ROOT'S s_0 IS TEXTURE (ungated; g12's convention): the first-order ledger needs s_raw at all three roots, but the adjudication uses s_0 at the cons roots only; the locked FD probes are recorded as co-reads without a hard gate (g11's same-instrument G_SENSDIR PASSED at this exact root, eps {0.05, 0.02} monotone).

THE ASYMMETRY CLAUSE'S JOINT READING (disclosed, frozen): 'the removals fail to spare' is read as BOTH removals failing (the reading that keeps GRADED reachable); the singular reading is recorded in the operationalization; adjudication is iff-exclusive per g12's convention.

THE g1f TRANSPLANT + THE g1f g_0-FORM REMOVAL ARE TABLED, NOT ADJUDICATED: the letter's frozen clauses name the fourth cell (singular, at g1e) + the two removals; the g1f replicate frame rides verbatim in the table (its own-landing reference cell is a GATE, tol 0.02 vs the committed 0.2577).
NO WASH CONTINUATION: each intervention is a SINGLE first-step application + the standard +1 read (the letter's cell); the +2 re-capture phase (the wall's own) is not tested here.
